india_trends.summary: The 30-share Sensex rose 0.75% for the week, while the broader Nifty 50 gained 0.53%, with most of the gains coming on Friday. The Nifty jumped 1.1% to close at 24,334.30, while the Sensex advanced 1.25% to settle at 78,151.44, its highest closing level since 12 June 2026.

india_trends.title: Reliance Q1 results: Profit falls 22% YoY to ₹20,946 crore

india_trends.title: J&K Bank sells 0.5% stake in PNB MetLife for Rs 120 crore
india_trends.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Bank has sold a 0.5% stake in PNB MetLife India Insurance to MetLife International Holdings for Rs 120 crore. The transaction reduces the bank’s holding to 2.5% without changing control of the life insurance company.
